testCases.title: Login page loads correctly
testCases.expectedResult: Login page loads with Username field, Password field, and Login button visible within 3 seconds

testCases.title: Empty username and password validation
testCases.expectedResult: Validation error shown: 'Username is required' or similar. Form does not submit.

testCases.title: Invalid credentials error message
testCases.expectedResult: Error message displayed: 'Invalid username or password'. Form does not submit.

testCases.title: Successful login with valid credentials
testCases.expectedResult: User is authenticated and navigated to home page. Dashboard is visible.
